name: OCPN Viewer
author: István Koren
description: A second renderer for Object-Centric Petri Nets: React Flow for rendering, elkjs (layered algorithm, run synchronously — the sandboxed view boundary's CSP blocks Web Workers) for layout. Source places show a Play glyph, sink places a Stop glyph, in place of the host view's double-ring notation. Ships alongside the host's own OCPN view so the two renderers can be compared side by side.

direction.title: Flow direction
direction.description: Which way the net runs across the canvas. Left to right is the usual reading order; top to bottom suits a long chain of transitions in a tall panel.
